messages:
Priya (Release): heads-up — critical auth-header regression hitting eu-dedicated canary since ~23:10 UTC, ~0.6% 401s. Need expedited hotfix pin + release-note scrub. Target window 00:30-01:00 UTC tonight. Deploy queued; need 2 approvals.

DeployBot: New hotfix deploy queued: release/v2.1.3-hotfix -> env: eu-dedicated. Canary: 5% for 10m. Rollback target: v2.1.2. Required approvals: 2. Use `/approve` to approve.

Maya: on it. quick Q — any DB/schema migrations in this?

Priya (Release): no migrations. Pure header parsing fix (token extraction). Safe rollback to v2.1.2.

Sam: I'll scrub release notes and docs. pinging PR for notes: <https://github.com/redwood/release/456|PR #456>.

Jen (Ops): I'm oncall tonight, +1 pending CI and canary metrics. I'll monitor memory & 5xx.

Diego: can someone paste the pin command so I can run it from standby?

Priya (Release): pin command: `releaser pin --env eu-dedicated --version v2.1.3-hotfix --reason "auth 401 regression"`

Maya: running smoke now: `make smoke-eu`

Maya: smoke OK locally, no 401s in the quick run.

Sam: docs PR updated with short notes + rollback steps. <https://github.com/redwood/release/456|PR #456> :memo:

Jen (Ops): +1 (CI green, looks good on my end)

Diego: +1 from me, standby for monitoring.

Maya: +1, verified canary testpack against proxy headers.

DeployBot: Approval count: 3/2. Initiating canary rollout now.

DeployBot: Canary metrics after 10m: latency p50=32ms p95=120ms, 5xx=0.0%, 401 rate <=0.01%. No regressions detected. :white_check_mark:

Priya (Release): promoting to 100% in 2m if no regressions. Release notes link: <https://github.com/redwood/release/456|PR #456>.

Oncall Bot: Reminder set for 00:45 UTC to recheck canary dashboards and 01:05 UTC for final verification.

Priya (Release): rollout complete and pinned. Tagging release notes and archiving thread. Good work team :tada:

Maya: nice, glad that was quick.

Sam: added changelog entry and sent to #release-announce for tomorrow morning.

Jen (Ops): leaving a short postmortem note in the incident tracker with root cause and mitigation steps.

DeployBot: Deploy finished: release/v2.1.3-hotfix successfully promoted to eu-dedicated (100%). Logs: <https://deploy.redwood.internal/logs/1718012345|view logs>.
